## Phase 1: Core Provider Infrastructure

### Goals
- Set up Go project structure
- Implement provider configuration (host, token)
- Create HTTP client with rate limiting
- Add error handling patterns

### Deliverables
- `main.go` - Provider entry point
- `internal/provider/provider.go` - Configuration
- HTTP client with auth support
- Unit tests for client

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Provider compiles and loads
- [ ] Can configure custom registry host
- [ ] Token auth works for private registries
- [ ] Rate limiting prevents API abuse

title: [Phase 2] Provider Data Sources
close_reason: Implemented registry_provider, registry_provider_versions, registry_search with acceptance tests

comments.author: Paul Thrasher
comments.text:
## Phase 2: Provider Data Sources

### Goals
- Implement provider-related data sources
- Connect to Registry API v1

### Data Sources
1. `registry_provider` - Get provider details (namespace, name, description, tier, downloads)
2. `registry_provider_versions` - List available versions with protocols
3. `registry_search` - Search providers with filters (namespace, tier)

### API Endpoints
- GET /v1/providers/{namespace}/{name}
- GET /v1/providers/{namespace}/{name}/versions
- GET /v1/providers?q={query}

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] registry_provider returns all attributes
- [ ] registry_provider_versions lists versions correctly
- [ ] registry_search supports filtering
- [ ] All have acceptance tests

## Phase 3: Module Data Sources

### Goals
- Implement module-related data sources
- Support module search and details

### Data Sources
1. `registry_module` - Get module details (namespace, name, provider, description, verified)
2. `registry_module_versions` - List available versions
3. Extend `registry_search` for type="modules"

### API Endpoints
- GET /v1/modules/{namespace}/{name}/{provider}
- GET /v1/modules/{namespace}/{name}/{provider}/versions
- GET /v1/modules?q={query}

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] registry_module returns all attributes
- [ ] registry_module_versions lists correctly
- [ ] Search works for modules
- [ ] Provider filter works on module search

comments.author: Paul Thrasher
comments.text:
## Phase 4: Schema Support

### Goals
- Fetch and expose provider schemas
- Make resource/data source attributes available

### Data Sources
1. `registry_provider_schema` - Get full provider schema
   - provider_schema: provider block schema
   - resource_schemas: map of resource type → schema
   - data_source_schemas: map of data source type → schema
   - functions: map of function signatures (TF 1.8+)

### Implementation Notes
- May need to fetch provider binary and extract schema
- Or use registry schema endpoint if available
- Schema parsing can be complex (nested blocks, types)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Can retrieve schema for a provider version
- [ ] Resource schemas include all attributes
- [ ] Attribute metadata (required, optional, computed, sensitive)
- [ ] Nested block types handled correctly

comments.author: Paul Thrasher
comments.text:
## Phase 5: Documentation

### Goals
- Fetch provider documentation as markdown
- Support resource, data source, and guide docs

### Data Sources
1. `registry_provider_docs` - Get documentation content
   - doc_type: "resources", "data-sources", "guides"
   - doc_name: specific document name
   - Returns: markdown content, title, category

### Use Cases
- Generate documentation sites
- Include docs in automation
- Build doc aggregation tools

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Can fetch resource documentation
- [ ] Can fetch data source documentation
- [ ] Can fetch guide documentation
- [ ] Returns valid markdown
- [ ] Category/subcategory metadata included

title: [Phase 6] Policy Libraries

comments.author: Paul Thrasher

## Phase 6: Policy Libraries

### Goals
- Support Sentinel and OPA policy libraries
- Query policy library metadata

### Data Sources
1. `registry_policy_library` - Get policy library info
   - namespace, name
   - Description
   - Available policies
   - Sentinel/OPA support

### Implementation Notes
- Policy libraries are a separate section of registry
- May have different API structure
- Lower priority - implement after core features

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Can list policy libraries
- [ ] Can get library details
- [ ] Policies enumerated
- [ ] Works for both Sentinel and OPA
